scientific_integrity: Direct algebra and an analytical global-attraction argument establish the theorem; finite reproducibility checks are auxiliary and do not certify originality or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic period-two survival applied after quadratic density-dependent recruitment; no claims about yield, variable fishing costs, stochastic environments or other nonlinearities. Results are exact within this stated model.
title: Exact finite-amplitude resonance boundary for alternating survival in a quadratic population map
